deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit is a behavioral/consistency change (not a compile-time API break) in shared spec-decode cudagraph sizing, and vllm-ascend both invokes and mirrors the modified code, so it requires realignment:

1. platform.py::_get_default_max_cudagraph_capture_size (line 1344) is a hand-maintained mirror of the exact upstream default-max branch this commit rewrites. Update it to consume the new VllmConfig.uniform_decode_query_len property (returns 1 + num_speculative_tokens) instead of recomputing `1 + speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens`. Critically, upstream now appends `n * decode_query_len` uniform-decode sizes to cudagraph_capture_sizes and raises max_cudagraph_capture_size to the widest uniform decode batch (up to max_num_batched_tokens), but this only runs when `max_cudagraph_capture_size is None`. Because apply_config_platform_defaults injects a non-None max (capped at 512), the new fix is suppressed on NPU and the widest uniform decode batch is still not captured by default for EAGLE/MTP/DFlash/DSpark. Reconcile: either stop injecting the default when spec decode is enabled so upstream appending takes effect, or replicate the uniform-decode appending with the existing 512 NPU memory cap (hardware stream/memory limits on Atlas 300I DUO / 910 series).

2. utils.py::_compute_potential_max_tokens (line 1046) and update_cudagraph_capture_sizes (line 614) compute `max_num_seqs * uniform_decode_query_len` independently; align them with the new centralized property and the new default semantics so the 'max_cudagraph_capture_size smaller than potential decode tokens' warning and the capture-size override logic stay consistent with upstream.

3. compiler_interface.py::_compute_decode_cudagraph_batch_sizes (line 71) recomputes `uniform_decode_query_len = num_spec_tokens + 1`; switch to `vllm_config.uniform_decode_query_len` to avoid drift.

4. Validate inherited graph managers on NPU: ModelAclGraphManager, DFlashAclGraphManager, AutoRegressiveAclGraphManager all inherit CudaGraphManager._init_candidates, whose dynamic-SD decode_query_lens derivation changed from reading each schedule tuple's K to building a dense schedule via build_dynamic_sd_schedule_lookup (clamping K to num_speculative_tokens, carrying K through gaps/tail). This changes the set of captured FULL decode graphs for DSpark/DFlash; re-verify collect_sorted_captured_token_sizes -> set_graph_params/set_draft_graph_params keying.

5. patch_cudagraph.py::_create_padded_batch_descriptor asserts `num_tokens_padded % uniform_decode_query_len == 0`; new uniform-decode sizes are multiples of decode_query_len so padding holds, but re-check against the enlarged max capture size in _bs_to_padded_graph_size.

6. Add regression tests (tests/ut/) for spec-decode capture-size behavior on NPU mirroring the new upstream tests (tests/compile/test_config.py, tests/v1/cudagraph/test_cudagraph_manager.py).
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. No compile/runtime API break (additive property + inherited behavior change), but behavioral divergence: (1) the injected max_cudagraph_capture_size in apply_config_platform_defaults suppresses the new uniform-decode appending, so the bug this commit fixes (missing widest uniform decode batch graphs) persists on NPU unless the mirror is updated; (2) if ascend adopts the upstream appending without the 512 cap, capture sizes can reach max_num_seqs*(1+num_spec_tokens) (e.g. 512*17 tokens for 16-draft DSpark), increasing ACL graph count, capture time and memory, risking OOM on constrained hardware; (3) the dynamic-SD decode_query_lens change alters which FULL decode graphs are captured for DSpark/DFlash on NPU and must be re-validated on device.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The core of this commit (FlashInfer MLA + DCP support for DSpark drafting, vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/flashinfer_mla.py: supports_non_causal_multi_token_dcp classvar and repeat_interleave of causal_seqlens_kv_global in forward_mqa) is CUDA/FlashInfer-only and is NOT used by vllm-ascend (it ships its own AscendMLA/DSA/SFA/FA3 backends; flashinfer_mla.py is listed in not_used_by_ascend). No adaptation is needed there. Two shared-code changes need verification only, not code changes: (1) MLAAttentionSpec.merge (vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py) now asserts that all MLA layers in a KV cache group agree on non_causal_multi_token_decode instead of OR-ing them. vllm-ascend's AscendMLAAttentionSpec.merge (vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py:85-88) already enforces this exact strict agreement before calling super().merge(), so behavior is unchanged and the new assert cannot fire on Ascend paths - confirm the Kimi-K3 DSpark draft MLA (vllm_ascend/models/kimi_k3_dspark.py:93, non_causal_multi_token_decode=not _uses_causal_draft_attention) is grouped separately from target layers, as it already must be. (2) The DCP-local seq-lens preparation was moved from DFlashSpeculator._build_draft_attn_metadata into the base DraftModelSpeculator._build_draft_attn_metadata (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/speculator.py, guarded by cp_size > 1). AscendDFlashSpeculator inherits the upstream DFlash class and runs with CP_SIZE=1 (no DCP), so this is a no-op; AscendDSparkSpeculator and the autoregressive speculator call the base method without dcp_local_seq_lens, so for any future DCP + spec-decode (DSpark/Eagle) on Ascend the draft metadata will now carry freshly prepared dcp_local_seq_lens - verify it is compatible with the Ascend builders (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py, vllm_ascend/attention/utils.py, context_parallel/common_cp.py get_dcp_local_seq_lens). No functional regression is expected.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. FlashInfer MLA DSpark+DCP is a CUDA-only feature with zero impact on Ascend attention backends. The MLAAttentionSpec.merge tightening matches vllm-ascend's existing stricter behavior (its own assertion guarantees agreement before super().merge()), so no break is possible on the Ascend path. The speculator DCP seq-lens change is guarded by cp_size > 1 and is a no-op for Ascend DFlash (CP_SIZE always 1); residual risk is limited to the DSpark/Eagle-on-DCP case, where the base class now pre-populates dcp_local_seq_lens that Ascend builders consume - only relevant if Ascend enables DCP with spec decode, and should be validated then.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
本 commit（[Bugfix][Mooncake] Save exact Mamba boundary states #51358）将生产者侧 Mamba 边界状态的传递机制从 partial-tail offload 重构为 boundary-state offload，并对上游核心接口做了破坏性重命名。vllm-ascend 有两个自定义调度器直接复制了上游 Scheduler.schedule() 的旧逻辑，必须同步适配：

1) vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py（硬破坏）：
   - 第 983 行 `self.kv_cache_manager.take_partial_tail_offloads()` 在 KVCacheManager 中被重命名为 `take_boundary_state_offloads()`，改名后该方法不存在 → AttributeError。
   - 第 1017 行向 `RecomputeSchedulerOutput(SchedulerOutput)` 传 `partial_tail_offloads=` 关键字，而 SchedulerOutput 该字段已被移除并替换为 `kv_connector_block_state: KVConnectorBlockState` → 每次 schedule() 都会 TypeError（与是否启用 connector 无关）。
   - 需按新上游逻辑改写：无条件调用 `self.kv_cache_manager.take_boundary_state_offloads()`；当 `self.connector is not None` 时用 `self.kv_cache_manager.get_block_ids(req_id)` 为 scheduled new/cached 请求及 offload 请求构造 `KVConnectorBlockState(block_ids={...}, boundary_state_offloads=...)` 并传入 `kv_connector_block_state=`；在把 SchedulerOutput 派发给 worker 前将 `kv_connector_block_state` 置 None（见上游 scheduler.py 修改）。

2) vllm_ascend/core/dyntra_lb_scheduler.py（静默回归）：
   - 第 1111-1124 行用 `self._scheduler_output_supports("partial_tail_offloads")`（检查 SchedulerOutput.__dataclass_fields__）和 `getattr(self.kv_cache_manager, "take_partial_tail_offloads", None)` 做防御式调用。commit 后字段/方法均不存在，该分支被静默跳过 → 边界状态不再被 drain，Mooncake 生产者侧 Mamba 混合前缀缓存失效（正是本 commit 修复的 bug 在 Ascend 上复现），且 MambaManager 中 `_pending_boundary_state_offloads` 会残留旧条目。
   - 需用同样的新逻辑替换：无条件 `take_boundary_state_offloads()` + 构造 `KVConnectorBlockState` + `scheduler_output_kwargs["kv_connector_block_state"] = ...`（第 1164-1165 行），并在 dispatch 前置 None。

3) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_mamba_manager.py（兼容性验证，低工作量）：
   - AscendMambaManager 仅覆写 find_longest_cache_hit 和 get_num_blocks_to_allocate（签名未变），其余改动随继承生效：MambaManager 新增 `_relocate_speculative_block()`（断言 `BlockPool.is_block_writable`，BlockPool 新增方法非破坏性）；align 模式下 allocate()/pop_blocks_for_free() 行为变化；`_pending_partial_tail_offloads`→`_pending_boundary_state_offloads`、`take_pending_partial_tail_offloads`→`take_pending_boundary_state_offloads`；`_update_num_cached_blocks_after` 现在对每个保留 boundary 生成 offload offer。需在 Ascend 上回归 Mamba align 混合前缀缓存 + PD 分离 Mooncake 场景。

4) 其它：vllm-ascend 的 ascend_store（kv_pool/ascend_store/）是上游 MooncakeStoreScheduler 的并行实现，未直接导入上游 store scheduler/worker/coordinator（grep 确认），故上游 store 文件的重命名与 mamba_group_ids/exclude_mamba 改动不直接破坏它；但其不消费 kv_connector_block_state，不涉及。上游 offloading/scheduler.py 的改动也不影响 vllm-ascend（未引用该类）。
deep_analysis.risk: 中。若不适配：(1) RecomputeScheduler（含 AsyncRecomputeScheduler、DyntraLBRecomputeScheduler 等，Ascend 在 finegrained_tp 等场景默认启用）会在 schedule() 处因 `partial_tail_offloads=` 参数抛出 TypeError（必现，与 connector 无关）；(2) DyntraLBScheduler 静默关闭边界状态交接，PD 分离下 Mamba 混合前缀缓存退化（重新触发本 commit 修复的 bug）；(3) AscendMambaManager 继承的新 align 分配/relocate 逻辑若与 Ascend 的自定义 Mamba 块处理（AscendMambaManager/patch_mamba_utils）不兼容，可能导致 speculative block 迁移断言失败或边界状态落盘错误。改动集中在两个自定义调度器的 schedule() 与 AscendMambaManager 兼容性验证，无新增公共接口，回归面可控。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit fixes cache-hit truncation so that EVERY full-attention KV-cache group (target AND draft, e.g. DeepSeek-V4 C4/C128 or DSpark target+draft) is truncated to the final hit_length in both HybridKVCacheCoordinator.find_longest_cache_hit (vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_coordinator.py) and the MooncakeStoreCoordinator mirror (vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/mooncake/store/coordinator.py). vllm-ascend does NOT use the upstream mooncake store module (MooncakeConnectorStoreV1 is re-registered to vllm_ascend.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_pool.ascend_store.ascend_store_connector with its own KVPoolScheduler/KVPoolWorker and own ZMQ lookup protocol), so the store protocol/worker/scheduler/connector changes and the resolve_dcp_kv_cache_spec / partial_hash_hits_enabled(dcp_world_size) additions do not run on Ascend. The core scheduler-side coordinator is already aligned (AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.find_longest_cache_hit at vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py:481-495 already truncates all full-attention groups). The ONE gap is the store-side mirror: AscendStoreCoordinator._find_hit_blocks (vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/ascend_store/coordinator.py:287-294) still truncates only attention_groups[0] when it is a FullAttentionSpec. Required change: replace the first-group-only block with a loop over all self.attention_groups, and for each group whose spec is a FullAttentionSpec compute num_blocks = cdiv(hit_length, <effective_block_size>) using the per-group effective block size (self.group_effective_block_sizes[group_id], since attention_groups store effective_specs with DCP-scaled block_size), then del hit_blocks_by_group[group_id][num_blocks:] and set hit_length_by_group[group_id] = hit_length — exactly mirroring the upstream MooncakeStoreCoordinator fix. Also verify-only (no change required for this commit): patch_kv_cache_utils.py::_ascend_resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes still delegates dcp==1 to _orig_resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes whose behavior is unchanged (resolve_dcp_kv_block_size is identity at dcp==1; the upstream refactor only changes dcp>1 UniformType attention-group scaling, which Ascend handles via its own lcm*dpc branch); and note AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.enable_partial_hash_hits (patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py:166-171/275-280) still lacks the dcp_world_size>1 branch that upstream core already has (pre-existing divergence, not introduced by this commit). Consider adding a regression unit test in tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store/test_coordinator.py with two full-attention groups, mirroring the upstream test additions (test_mooncake_store_worker.py).
deep_analysis.risk: Low-to-medium. The missing mirror fix is a correctness issue confined to the Ascend store (PD disaggregation) path: for hybrid models with multiple full-attention groups under DCP/hybrid prefix caching, the non-first full-attention group keeps prefix-cache blocks beyond the converged hit_length, which can cause stale/over-long cache reuse or inconsistent per-group hit handling. The change is small and has a direct reference implementation in the already-correct sibling AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator, so the main risk is incorrect effective-block-size selection in the truncation loop; otherwise the upstream MooncakeStore coordinator/worker/protocol changes do not touch vllm-ascend's own store implementation.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Commit 2aac565cae88 changes WHEN connector KV loads start: it adds SchedulerOutput.has_sync_kv_loads (default False), makes the upstream Scheduler set it True when a running request has num_external_computed_tokens > 0 with a synchronous load, and defers kv_connector.start_load_kv() to AFTER the forward launch when it is False (in KVConnectorModelRunnerMixin._get_kv_connector_output and ActiveKVConnector.pre_forward/post_forward). It also moves load/store submission out of get_finished() into start_load_kv()/wait_for_save() in upstream SimpleCPUOffloadConnector and vllm/v1/simple_kv_offload/worker.py. Required vllm-ascend work: (1) SimpleCPUOffloadNPUWorker: upstream SimpleCPUOffloadWorker.start_load_kv()/wait_for_save() are now live (launching copies, wait_for_save uses torch.cuda.current_stream()) but the NPU worker only overrides get_finished (which still submits transfers) and does NOT override start_load_kv/wait_for_save. This will break on NPU (torch.cuda) and double-submit transfers. Add NPU (torch.npu) overrides for start_load_kv/wait_for_save and strip the transfer submission from get_finished, mirroring the new upstream state machine. (2) AscendSimpleCPUOffloadConnector inherits the modified upstream SimpleCPUOffloadConnector.start_load_kv/wait_for_save delegation; keep compatible with the NPU worker (or re-override to no-op if keeping get_finished-driven flow). (3) Custom schedulers DyntraLBScheduler, ProfilingChunkScheduler, RecomputeScheduler construct SchedulerOutput/RecomputeSchedulerOutput without has_sync_kv_loads (defaults False), so sync KV loads they schedule would be started after the forward → correctness bug. Compute has_sync_kv_loads when appending a running request with num_external_computed_tokens > 0 (mirror upstream scheduler.py), using the existing _scheduler_output_supports pattern in dyntra_lb_scheduler.py. (4) Verify all vllm-ascend connectors' start_load_kv (mooncake, mooncake_hybrid, mooncake_layerwise, sfa_pd_rd2h, ascend_store, ucm, recompute_cpu_offload) are safe when invoked after the forward launch on async-only steps, and that wait_for_save is still reached (it now runs in the mixin/ActiveKVConnector path, not in get_finished).
deep_analysis.risk: High for the simple CPU offload path: inheriting the new upstream start_load_kv/wait_for_save would call torch.cuda.current_stream() on NPU (crash) and the overridden get_finished would double-submit transfers (silent KV corruption). Medium for the custom schedulers: omitting has_sync_kv_loads defers synchronous loads past the forward, causing reads of unloaded KV. Medium for mooncake/sfa/ascend_store connectors: only a timing change (start_load_kv after forward on async steps); functional if their loads are genuinely async, but each connector's start_load_kv/wait_for_save semantics must be audited against the new contract.

Signed-off-by: Keyi Li <likey6688@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Keyi Li <likey6688@gmail.com>

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This upstream commit ([Perf] Split xdrope_positions H2D copy into per-row transfers) changes GPUModelRunner's XD-RoPE position H2D copy in vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py from a single strided-slice copy_ (self.xdrope_positions.gpu[:, :N].copy_(cpu[:, :N])) into a per-row loop, to avoid the pageable-fallback silent stream sync triggered by copying a non-contiguous strided view of a pinned CpuGpuBuffer (same fix previously applied to mrope_positions in PR #51841). vllm-ascend maintains forked copies of this exact input-preparation code path that will NOT receive the change automatically: (1) NPUModelRunnerV1.prepare_inputs in vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py:1316-1322 and (2) NPUModelRunner310 (inherits NPUModelRunnerV1) in vllm_ascend/_310p/model_runner_310p.py:456-461 both still use the single strided-slice copy_. Adapt by mirroring the upstream pattern in both locations: replace the slice copy_ with `for row in range(self.xdrope_positions.gpu.shape[0]): self.xdrope_positions.gpu[row, :total_num_scheduled_tokens].copy_(self.xdrope_positions.cpu[row, :total_num_scheduled_tokens], non_blocking=True)` (keeping the preceding `self._calc_xdrope_positions(scheduler_output)` call and the `uses_xdrope_dim > 0` guard). The buffer is allocated as (uses_xdrope_dim, max_num_tokens + 1) with a trailing dummy column, so per-row slices are contiguous within the pinned allocation and preserve genuinely async non_blocking copies. No changes are needed in the v2 path (NPUModelRunner in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py fully overrides prepare_inputs and does not perform this xdrope H2D copy), nor in spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py (its xdrope_positions is a plain device tensor, not a CpuGpuBuffer with an H2D copy).
deep_analysis.risk: Low. The change is behavior-preserving (perf-only): identical data is transferred in the same order, so no correctness impact on XD-RoPE (e.g. HunYuan-VL) decoding. Main risks to verify on NPU hardware: (1) confirm torch_npu .copy_() on per-row contiguous pinned slices does not fall back to a pageable-sync path and does not add measurable per-row launch overhead in the hot path (the loop is tiny, bounded by uses_xdrope_dim, typically 4); (2) ensure parity with the mrope path so the two RoPE buffers behave consistently. No signature/API changes, so no compile-time breakage for OOT platforms.
